crm_notes:
Top-line: SMB ecommerce platform using LLM-based chat + quick answer summarization in support widget. Self-serve sign-up then early discovery. Primary pain: traffic spikes tied to marketing/holiday pushes -> transient 429s and unpredictable throttling. Wants clear backoff semantics and a small-burst allowance so agents and customers don't see degraded UX.

Key technical asks / quotes: "We have short, sharp spikes when campaign emails hit — it's not sustained but it breaks the chat. Need predictable behavior: if we hit a limit, tell us when we can retry (Retry-After) and ideally allow a small burst to finish flows."

Requirements summary: rate limiting by API key, per-minute token quotas, graceful 429s with Retry-After or X-RateLimit headers, optional burst window (token bucket style), client SDK support for jittered exponential backoff, per-route prioritization (agent-facing vs public widget), monitoring + alerting for 429 spikes, clear pricing for overage/spike credits. SOC2 + SSO required for production.

Acceptance criteria for POC:
- No more than 0.5% failed user-facing requests due to 429 during a simulated 5x marketing spike (70 -> 350 RPS) for 2 minutes.
- 429 responses include Retry-After and remaining_quota header or equivalent.
- Documented cost impact for burst scenarios (example: 10k extra tokens per promo).

Next steps (AE/SE): Jordan to schedule POC kickoff w/ engineering 2026-03-15. Maya to drop stress-test harness + expected metrics template. Customer to provide sample traffic curve and peak token sizes.
